headline: Digjam Limited NCLT Convened General Meeting – Scrutiniser's Report Filed
sum: Digjam Limited filed the Scrutiniser's Report and voting results from an NCLT-convened shareholder meeting held 16 August 2026, signalling completion of a court-ordered corporate action requiring shareholder approval.
implication: An NCLT-convened meeting (rather than ordinary AGM) typically signals insolvency, scheme of arrangement, or merger proceedings; scrutiniser report filing to exchange marks formal closure of voting and signals next procedural step (Board approval or regulator confirmation).
detail: The company submitted the formal Scrutiniser's Report to NSE following the completion of voting at the NCLT Convened General Meeting. The filing confirms the voting results and shareholder approval status on the resolution(s) placed before the meeting. The timing and regulatory format suggest a formal corporate restructuring or compromise/arrangement under the Companies Act, 2013 that required NCLT intervention and shareholder sanction.
